label: Следовать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for следовать (to follow).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Следую' is the 1sg present of imperfective следовать, an -овать verb whose -ова- becomes -у- in the present. It takes the dative, here 'своим принципам'.

missions.phrase: Ты следуешь за мной слишком близко.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Следуешь' is the 2sg present of следовать, with the -у- stem and -ешь ending. With 'за' plus instrumental it means to follow physically behind someone.

Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Следует' is the 3sg present of следовать with -ет. Taking the dative 'правилам', it means he strictly follows the rules; this form also serves the impersonal 'one should'.

missions.phrase: Мы следуем за гидом по музею.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Следуем' is the 1pl present of следовать with the -у- stem and -ем. With 'за' plus instrumental it describes following the guide through the museum.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Следуют' is the 3pl present of следовать with -ют, closing the present ladder. Taking the dative 'моде', it means they follow fashion.

missions.phrase: Он молча следовал за нами по тропинке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Следовал' is the past m. sg. of imperfective следовать, where the full -ова- stem returns in the past. The imperfective stresses the continuous act of following along the path.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Следовала' is the past f. sg. of следовать with -ла on the -ова- stem. Taking the dative 'советам', it reports her habit of following the doctor's advice.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Следовали' is the past pl. of следовать with -ли. With the dative 'приказу' it means the soldiers were following a strict order.

missions.phrase: Следуй за мной, я знаю дорогу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Следуй' is the informal command of следовать, formed from the present stem следу- plus -й. With 'за' plus instrumental it tells one person to come along behind me.

Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Следовать' is the bare infinitive after the modal 'надо'. It takes the dative 'инструкции' and, with 'внимательно', states one must follow the instructions carefully.
